description: This Java class 'LocalFileDownloader' handles local file downloads from 'file:///' URIs, providing methods for input stream retrieval, download management, and file change detection within the fdroid project.

classes.name: LocalFileDownloader
classes.description: A class that manages downloading files from local file URIs, extending the Downloader class, with methods for input stream access, download execution, and change detection.

methods.name: LocalFileDownloader
methods.description: Constructor initializing the downloader with URI, index file, and destination file.

methods.name: getInputStream
methods.description: Returns an InputStream for the local file, converting filesystem errors to network-like exceptions.

methods.name: hasChanged
methods.description: Indicates whether the file has changed; always returns true.

methods.name: totalDownloadSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the source file.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Performs the download operation, handling file existence, size checks, and resumability.
